9834-the-talleyrand-maxim.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. nd patience, which is valuable to young men of his peculiar qualities, a thing also much beloved by Talleyrand--opportunity. He could find the patience, and he had the time--but it would give him great happiness if opportunity came along to help in the work. In everyday language, Linford Pratt wanted a chance--he waited the arrival of the tide in his affairs which would lead him on to fortune.

arxiv-2011-07708.title: An explicit computation of the Hecke operator and the ghost conjecture
arxiv-2011-07708.creator: Nha Xuan Truong
arxiv-2011-07708.description: Abstract 1. Introduction Let p be a prime number, and N be a positive integer co-prime to p . For an integer k\geq 3 , we use S_{k}\big(\Gamma_{1}(pN)\big) to denote the space of modular cuspforms of weight k , level \Gamma_{1}(pN) . A modular form f in S_{k}\big(\Gamma_{1}(pN)\big) can be written as f(\tau)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_{n}(f)q^{n},\ q=e^{2\pi i\tau}.

arxiv-2104-00539.title: A Stochastic Gradient Descent Theorem and the Back-Propagation Algorithm
arxiv-2104-00539.creator: Hao Wu
arxiv-2104-00539.description: Abstract . We establish a convergence theorem for a certain type of stochastic gradient descent, which leads to a convergent variant of the back-propagation algorithm. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 41A60 1. A Convergence Theorem for Stochastic Gradient Descent 1.1.

arxiv-2301-13594.title: View fusion vis-à-vis a Bayesian interpretation of Black-Litterman for portfolio allocation.
arxiv-2301-13594.creator: Trent Spears, Stefan Zohren, Stephen Roberts
arxiv-2301-13594.description: Abstract Summary The Black-Litterman model extends the framework of the Markowitz Modern Portfolio Theory to incorporate investor views. We consider a case where multiple view estimates, including uncertainties, are given for the same underlying subset of assets at a point in time. This motivates our consideration of data fusion techniques for combining information from multiple sources.

arxiv-2408-03632.title: Concept Conductor: Orchestrating Multiple Personalized Concepts in Text-to-Image Synthesis
arxiv-2408-03632.creator: Zebin Yao, Fangxiang Feng, Ruifan Li, Xiaojie Wang
arxiv-2408-03632.description: Abstract The customization of text-to-image models has seen significant advancements, yet generating multiple personalized concepts remains a challenging task. Current methods struggle with attribute leakage and layout confusion when handling multiple concepts, leading to reduced concept fidelity and semantic consistency.

arxiv-2411-17028.title: Longitudinal tapering in gas jets for increased efficiency of 10-GeV class laser plasma accelerators
arxiv-2411-17028.creator: R. Li ∗, A. Picksley, C. Benedetti, F. Filippi, J. Stackhouse, L. Fan-Chiang, H. E. Tsai, K. Nakamura, C. B. Schroeder, J. van Tilborg, E. Esarey, C. G. R. Geddes, A. J. Gonsalves
arxiv-2411-17028.description: Abstract Modern laser plasma accelerators (LPAs) often require plasma waveguides tens of cm long to propagate a high-intensity drive laser pulse. Tapering the longitudinal gas density profile in 10 cm scale gas jets could allow for single stage laser plasma acceleration well beyond 10 GeV with current petawatt-class laser systems.

arxiv-2507-08679.title: ByDeWay: Boost Your multimodal LLM with DEpth prompting in a training-free Way
arxiv-2507-08679.creator: Rajarshi Roy, Devleena Das, Ankesh Banerjee, Arjya Bhattacharjee, Kousik Dasgupta, Subarna Tripathi
arxiv-2507-08679.description: Abstract We introduce a training-free framework, ByDeWay , a training-free method to boost the performances of Multimodal Large Language Models. Specifically, ByDeWay leverages a novel prompting strategy, Layered-Depth-Based Prompting (LDP), that enhances the spatial reasoning and grounding capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).

arxiv-2510-17473.title: The Dark Matters at ICRC 2025
arxiv-2510-17473.description: Abstract The dark matter track at ICRC 2025 showed a field in transition. Direct detection has entered the neutrino-floor era , with XENONnT and PandaX-4T now limited by Solar neutrinos. Indirect searches have become truly multimessenger , combining γ \gamma -rays, neutrinos, cosmic rays, and radio data under unified likelihoods and shared systematics.

pmc-10607609.description: Small heat shock proteins (sHSPs) represent a first line of stress defense in many bacteria.
